engine: EVER de-bleed/re-bleed — a full-bleed photo insets into a contained editorial card (a giant wordmark BEHIND it, revealed in the new gutters), the editorial copy rising in around it; reverse re-bleeds back out (gallery-open). Harvested from D_ever_walkthrough (SEAM B/D, reverse f_043).

measured_teardown.move: as you scroll INTO the section the full-bleed image shrinks to a centred card via a growing clip-path inset (or scale), so the wordmark behind + editorial copy/decor appear in the freed margins. Scroll OUT (or 'open') re-bleeds it back to full-bleed (the gallery-open animation). Scroll-scrubbed, reversible.
measured_teardown.cited: EVER SEAM B f029->f033, SEAM D f101->f104; the reverse (re-bleed = gallery open) at f_043.

insetX.what: final horizontal card inset at de-bleed end.

siblings.what: editorial elements that fade/rise in over the back half of the de-bleed.

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: DeBleed.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup: .db-stage > .db-word(behind, z1) + .db-media(img, z2) + [.db-around...](z3). Image clip-path insets inset(0)->inset(insetY% insetX% ...).
law: Lenis 1.1.13 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE; pin/scrub; clip-path + transform + opacity only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion/<=820px -> static contained-card pose. ONE scroll owner per page.
gate_mode: normal (the single media is always solid, just insetting; no two-render overlap; the slate around is intended margin) — blank/jank/fps standard.
proven: lab: OUR render full-bleed -> centred card (inset(0%) at top -> inset(11.4% 21%) at end), the word 'АРХІТЕКТУРА' behind showing in the gutters, eyebrow + copy rising in (opacity 0->1 over the back half). Gate PASS: 0 blank, 0 seam, 59.9fps, jank 1/735.
